summary: Nokia (6-K) announces the appointment of Emma Falck as President of Mobile Infrastructure and member of the Group Leadership Team, effective 1 September 2026. No financial terms or stake details are disclosed. The board, via CEO Justin Hotard, expresses confidence in Falck's transformation experience. This is a planned senior leadership change, not a forced departure. The filing is a foreign private issuer report mapping to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. Watch for any subsequent operational updates or strategic shifts under the new leadership.
